verdict.rationale: Antigravity is an agentic coding platform, so its AI suggestions come from the user's own code and files. The docs cover context-aware autocompletion and agent commands, and Artifacts deliver plans, architecture diagrams and data artifacts such as SQL and JSONL. The agent can also take documents and multimedia as context and reach databases through MCP. However, the evidence shows no dedicated feature for surfacing insights from user data; any analysis happens only when the user prompts the general-purpose agent. Missing for 10: a built-in data-insight or analytics surface, proactive insights generated from user data, and independent hands-on corroboration of data-analysis quality.
